itens.titulo: CVE-2026-123218: IBM Aspera Faspex Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
itens.resumo: IBM Aspera Faspex contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to craft a specific message to bypass authorization, causing privilege escalations.

itens.titulo: Google Issues Chrome Security Update for Eighth Actively Exploited Zero-Day of 2026
itens.resumo: Google on Monday released updates to patch nine security vulnerabilities, including one that has come under active exploitation in the wild. The high-severity vulnerability, assigned the CVE identifier CVE-2026-125350 (CVSS score: N/A), has been described as a use-after-free bug in the XML component. itens.titulo: Ransomware recovery is now a client retention metric
itens.resumo: Recovering from ransomware doesn't guarantee an MSP will retain its clients, especially when delays, poor communication, and unexpected costs undermine trust. itens.titulo: SAP Patches Four CVSS 10.0 Flaws, Including Two Enabling Remote Code Execution
itens.resumo: Four flaws that attackers could exploit without logging in were fixed today as part of SAP's monthly Security Patch Day—the vendor rates all four 10.0, the maximum CVSS score. Three are in the SAP NetWeaver application server, the software SAP systems run on, and one is in the Web Dispatcher, which receives web requests from the internet and passes them on to that server. itens.titulo: Hackers Compromise Ethersphere's bee-js and Swarm Desktop to Deliver Wallet-Stealing Malware
